Speakers – GCV Ambassadors

Ms. Nonny – Vice Executive Director, Global GCV Committee, Head of Indonesia GCV Ambassador
Global GCV Education Director

Nonny Padja NTT, the Training Director of Global GCV CT and Vice Chair of the Global GCV Core Team committee, as well as the GCV Global Ambassador and Head of the Indonesia GCV Ambassador.  With over 18 years of experience as a midwife in Singapore, Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan, she now leads the International Love Hope Branch. Since joining the Pi Network in September 2020, Nonny has been a driving force in GCV education, managing 20 Telegram groups and 10 WhatsApp groups to support pioneers. Through her leadership, she shares valuable insights via Ms. Doris Yin's articles across multiple platforms. Known as the Eagle Woman.

Speech

Good Morning, Good Afternoon, and Good Evening

Dear Industry Innovator Leaders, Ms. Doris Yin, Grand Global GCV Ambassador.
Ms. Lumari, Chair of the GCV International Alliance, Executive Director of CT, CT GCV, Global GCV Philippines.
Mr. Jojo, Vice Chair of the GCV International Alliance, Executive Assistant to CT GCV, Global GCV Vietnam.
Also, to the Core Committee and Core Team of GCV Global, whom I cannot mention individually. And also to all the Members of the GCV International Alliance who have joined us.
Amazing Audience, Tireless Innovators, Passionate GCV Ambassadors, and the Entire GCV Family!

Tonight, our Energy is on Fire! We are not just gathered, we are ready to ROCK! We are on the verge of a major shift, where GCV Technology will transform the way we live, work, and interact. Mainnet is just around the corner!

Mainnet: The Green Light for Innovation!

Mainnet is more than just a launch. It signals the beginning of a new era! An era where brilliant ideas become reality, where old boundaries crumble, and where limitless opportunities open up!

We’ve worked hard, we’ve sacrificed, and now, it’s time to reap the rewards! Mainnet is a testament to our resilience, a testament to our vision, and proof that we can do great things together!

Infrastructure? READY! We have a solid foundation, a secure network, and unmatched technology!

Community? READY! We have thousands of developers, innovators, and supporters ready to build a vibrant ecosystem!

Regulation? READY! We are working closely with the government to ensure that we operate with integrity and transparency!

GCV Ambassadors: Heroes on the Front Line!

GCV Ambassadors, you are the spearhead of change! You are the voice of GCV in society! You are an inspiration to the next generation!

I challenge you to:

TAKE ACTION! Don’t just talk, show! Demonstrate how GCV Technology can solve real problems!

COLLABORATE! Build bridges between developers, businesses, and government! Create extraordinary synergies!

SHINE! Be an example to others! Show that with GCV, we can achieve extraordinary things!

GCV Industry Alliance: An Unstoppable Force!

We can’t do this alone. We need the power of diverse industries! The GCV Industry Alliance is a place where:

Ideas Collide! Exchange, debate, and create innovative solutions!

Resources Unite! Combine expertise, capital, and networks to achieve common goals!

The Future is Built! Create industry standards, develop new products, and open new markets!

Let’s Move Now!

The Mainnet is ready, the Ambassadors are excited, and the Industry is united! Now, it’s our turn to:

JOIN! Don’t hesitate, don’t be afraid! Start adopting GCV Technology now!

CONTRIBUTE! Participate in community projects, provide feedback, and help others!

DREAM BIG! Imagine a better future, and use GCV Technology to make it happen!

With burning passion, strong determination, and unwavering faith, let’s make GCV a force that changes the world!

With Mainnet readiness, support from GCV Ambassadors, and the strength of the GCV Industry Alliance, I am confident we will build a brighter and more prosperous future.

Indonesia is ready to join the International GCV Alliance, to bridge all beloved Global Pioneers with ConsPindo Indonesia.

Respected:

Eagle Woman 
Nonny Padja NTT
Founder of the GCV Movement Indonesia, 
VGAGA Indonesian Ambassador

Cargo plane slides off runway in Hong Kong; 2 dead

LOOK: A cargo plane flying from Dubai skidded off the runway into the sea while landing at Hong Kong International Airport, the city's airport operator said on Monday, October 20, with local media reporting the deaths of two people.

The northern runway at the airport is closed after the incident, Hong Kong International Airport said, adding the south and central runways would continue to operate.

The accident occurred around 3:50 AM Manila time, and the airport confirmed the aircraft was carrying an Emirates flight number. Emirates did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.

The four crew members on board were reportedly rescued. Two people who were inside a ground vehicle near the runway that was suspected to have been struck by the aircraft have died, local media reported, citing police. | via Reuters

📷: Reuters
